scenes.headline: Stop clicking through Excel
scenes.narration: Most people lose hours a week to the mouse. These five Excel shortcuts will win some of that time back.

scenes.headline: Control plus arrow
scenes.narration: Control plus an arrow key jumps to the edge of your data in one move, however long the table is.

scenes.headline: Add shift to select
scenes.narration: Hold shift as well and Excel selects everything between where you are and the edge of the table.

scenes.headline: Alt plus equals
scenes.narration: Alt plus equals writes a sum formula for you and guesses the range. Press enter and you are done.

scenes.headline: F4 repeats and locks
scenes.narration: F4 repeats your last action, and inside a formula it cycles through locked cell references.

scenes.headline: Pick one and practise
scenes.narration: Choose one shortcut and use it all week. Follow for a new spreadsheet trick every few days.
